guidance_now: Capex for FY27 first stage in Odisha: INR1,500–2,000 crore.
Invest INR180 crore in second pharma intermediate plant, commissioning within 8 months.
Grow pharma share of specialty chemicals from ~10% to 20%.
Launch one active ingredient (AI) in FY26, two AIs in FY27.
Maintain strong capex plan for FY27.
bull: Revenue surged 32% YoY to ₹5,033 cr in Jun 2026 quarter.
EBITDA margin peaked at 24.6% in Jun 2026 quarter, the highest in the series.
Free cash flow turned positive, reaching ₹747 cr in FY26.
bear: FY25 capex of ₹1,482 cr exceeded guidance by over 15%.
EBITDA margin fell to 19.3% in Sep 2026 quarter, down from 24.6% in Jun 2026.
Pharma share target to double lacks measurable progress in financials.
questions: What is the expected timeline and budget allocation for the Odisha first-stage capex in FY27?
Can you break down FY26 investing cash flow to confirm the INR180 cr spend on the second pharma plant?
What progress has been made toward increasing pharma's share to 20% of specialty chemicals?
